query:
UPDATE streamer_plans
           SET manual_plan_id = $1,
               manual_plan_expires_at = $2,
               manual_plan_notes = $3,
               manual_plan_updated_at = $4
           WHERE twitch_user_id = (
               SELECT twitch_user_id
               FROM twitch_streamers_partner_state
               WHERE LOWER(twitch_login) = LOWER($5)
               LIMIT 1
           )
